segments.sn23.46:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ rādhaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn23.46:1.3: “yo kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn23.46:1.5: Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn23.46:1.6: Vedanā … pe … saññā … pe … saṅkhārā … pe … viññāṇaṃ nirodhadhammo;
segments.sn23.46:1.9: tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn23.46:1.10: Yo kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti.
segments.sn23.46:2.1: Māro ca māradhammo ca, aniccena apare duve;
segments.sn23.46:2.3: Dukkhena ca duve vuttā, anattena tatheva ca;
